info.title: Federal Communications Commission Universal API
info.description: Access FCC Public Inspection Files APIs for broadcast and cable facility data, contours, public file folders, files, search, history, and supported entity-management operations.

get.description: Retrieves FCC broadcast contour data by service and identifier.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format. FCC documents json, jsonp, shp, kml, gml, csv. Use json for normal API runs.

schema.description: Response format. FCC documents json, jsonp, shp, kml, gml, csv. Use json for normal API runs.

parameters.name: idType
parameters.description: Identifier type. Valid values include facilityid, callsign, filenumber, applicationid, antennaid.

schema.description: Identifier type. Valid values include facilityid, callsign, filenumber, applicationid, antennaid.

parameters.name: idValue
parameters.description: Identifier value for the selected ID type.

schema.description: Identifier value for the selected ID type.

parameters.name: serviceType
parameters.description: Contour service type. Valid values documented by FCC: tv, fm, am.

schema.description: Contour service type. Valid values documented by FCC: tv, fm, am.

parameters.name: stationClass
parameters.description: AM-only station class; ignored for TV and FM.

schema.description: AM-only station class; ignored for TV and FM.

parameters.name: timePeriod
parameters.description: AM-only time period; FCC currently documents day.

schema.description: AM-only time period; FCC currently documents day.
